title: Large Language Models for Patent Classification: Strengths, Trade-offs, and the Long Tail Effect

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance disparities across technological categories by stratifying Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC) subclasses into frequent (top 20% by support) and rare (bottom 20%) groups, and comparing per-label F1 scores, precision, and recall between encoder-based models and LLMs using paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests.
